name: Blockbuster Studio – AI Film Studio (Wan 2.2)
readme:
# Blockbuster Studio – AI Film Studio (Wan 2.2)

Your own AI film studio on one GPU: images, video, character-consistent editing, camera angles,
storyboarding and a timeline export — all self-hosted, no per-generation API fees.

## Quick start

1. Deploy this template on an **RTX 4090 24GB** (default, cheapest that fits everything) or a
   faster card (5090, L40S) if you want quicker generations.
2. Set **STUDIO_PASSWORD** to a password of your choice before deploying (recommended), or leave
   it blank and read the generated password from the pod logs / `/workspace/studio/PASSWORD.txt`
   after boot.
3. Wait for first boot: models (~90GB with the default groups) download in the background. Image
   generation is usable within a few minutes; video and edit follow as their model groups finish
   (about 10-20 minutes total on a fast connection).
4. Open the pod's HTTP port 3000 from the Runpod console (`Connect` → `HTTP Service`), or go to
   `https://<POD_ID>-3000.proxy.runpod.net`.

## Env vars

- `STUDIO_PASSWORD` – login password (auto-generated if left blank).
- `MODEL_GROUPS` – comma list of model groups to download on boot: `image,video,edit` (default),
  add `t2v` for text-to-video, or set to `all`.
- `HF_TOKEN` – optional, raises Hugging Face rate limits / needed for gated repos.
- `CIVITAI_TOKEN` – optional, for importing LoRAs from Civitai inside the app.
- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` – optional, enables AI script breakdown (script → scenes → shots) and prompt
  enhancement. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint also works via `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_BASE_URL`.

## Storage

Everything lives on the `/workspace` volume: models, your projects, and generated media. Stopping
the pod keeps the volume (and keeps billing for storage only). Terminating the pod deletes the
volume permanently.
